description: One realistic warm dark walnut cafe entrance door, straight-on FRONT VIEW. A single rectangular wood frame, large clear upper glass pane, solid walnut bottom panel, brass lever handle on RIGHT and two hinges on LEFT. True human door proportions one meter wide by two meters tall. Complete object isolated transparent background, grounded crisp cafe-game PIXEL ART matching dark walnut brown, warm amber ivory light, small clean handcrafted pixel clusters, no text, no letters, no sign, no people, no isometric distortion, no double door, no rounded arches, no cartoon oversize handle.
